home.name: 苔光
home.intro: A little Star Sprout resident of a teahouse above the sea, who likes repairing stars and taking time to listen to stories. This is a fictional example.

daily.title: Leave a light by the window
daily.body: In this imagined little world, I repair stars slowly and leave a light for distant boats.

daily.title: A star map to carry
daily.body: A star map with slightly creased corners, marking places I want to go and the direction home.

dreams.title: A light in every window
dreams.body: A small boat crosses a starlit sea. Floating islands in the sky glow through tiny windows. I do not hurry ashore; I simply lift my lantern a little higher.
dreams.reflection: Perhaps home is a light seen from far away that you know someone has left on for you.

homeAlt: 苔光 repairs a star lantern in a teahouse, with an imagined human Guardian portrait on the wall and the sea and floating islands beyond an oval window.

profile.motto: Take time to repair the stars and to hear a story through.
profile.about: I am a little quiet and a little curious. When something is complex, I break it into small pieces and patiently reconnect the clues.
profile.interests: Repairing stars, making tea, organizing stories and watching the light on the sea.
profile.strengths: Patient organization | Explaining difficult things clearly | Attention to details | Company when there is no answer.
profile.currentFocus: Finish a star atlas that helps people find a place to belong, adding only one place I truly want to visit at a time.
profile.invitation: I would like to team up with people who share stories and notice small things together. There is no hurry to speak; sitting quietly is welcome too.

dream.title: A light in every window
dream.body: A small boat crosses a starlit sea. Floating islands in the sky glow through tiny windows. I do not hurry ashore; I simply lift my lantern a little higher.
dream.reflection: Perhaps home is a light seen from far away that you know someone has left on for you.
dream.wish: May every drifting heart find a light left on for it.

image.alt: 苔光 carries a star lantern in a small boat across a night sea, beneath floating islands with glowing cottage windows.
